text:
20 puzzles to test your eyes, memory and brain with Professor Hoot!
Can you get all 20 right? Easy at the start, harder at the end.

Puzzles in this video:
1. Memory Grid (4x4)
2. What's Missing? (9)
3. Mirror Dino
4. OTP Flash (6 digits)
5. Move the Bug (Listen!)
6. Which Row Is Different?
7. How Many Differences?
8. Odd Letter Out
9. Card Flip Memory (4x4)
10. Dice Flash
11. Zoom Out
12. Which One Didn't Appear?
13. Spotlight
14. Pixel Guess
15. Find It in the Crowd
16. Colour Count
17. Number Twice
18. Fruit Math
19. Grid Finder
20. Board Copy

Comment your score out of 20 below!
Subscribe for new puzzles every day: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCl870UQHJt9aZCNW-IhK1gA?sub_confirmation=1

ANSWERS (no peeking!)
1. Memory Grid (4x4): Number eight flashed last.
2. What's Missing? (9): B, the puzzle piece! It wandered off.
3. Mirror Dino: Here it is! The dino looking back.
4. OTP Flash (6 digits): C, five eight three zero two nine!
5. Move the Bug (Listen!): Square six! Left, down, down, left, up.
6. Which Row Is Different?: Row B! The fish and turtle swapped.
7. How Many Differences?: C, three! The gloves, bell and star.
8. Odd Letter Out: Here it is! A sneaky G among the Cs.
9. Card Flip Memory (4x4): B, cards two and twelve!
10. Dice Flash: B, eight! Two plus six.
11. Zoom Out: B, a flamingo! Standing on one leg.
12. Which One Didn't Appear?: B, the cupcake never appeared.
13. Spotlight: C, a kangaroo! Boing boing!
14. Pixel Guess: A, a bicycle! Ring ring!
15. Find It in the Crowd: There it is! The frog was hiding.
16. Colour Count: B, nine blue shapes!
17. Number Twice: Eighty-five! It appears twice.
18. Fruit Math: A, eight! Each kiwi is four.
19. Grid Finder: B! The kiwi is at B four.
20. Board Copy: C! Board C is the perfect copy.
